author: Ankit
problem: A theater has rows x cols seats. booked lists the (row, col) seats that are taken. Return the seat map as a list of strings, one per row, with 'X' for a booked seat and '.' for a free one.
bug_description: Builds the grid with [['.'] * cols] * rows, so every row is the same list and booking one seat marks that column in every row.

comments.accurate: One string per row, with X for booked seats and . for free ones
comments.wrong_behavior: Seat map with X marking every column that has a booking, repeated on each row
comments.wrong_location: Grid setup verified; check that booked seats are given as (row, col), not (col, row)
